title: 第13章 纯粹入定炼气化神第14章 曹蒹葭
content_zh:
;;
鱼吞舟匆匆回了屋内，不仅关上了门，还寻来麻布，将窗也遮住了。
听人劝，吃饱饭。
接下来这段时日的晚上，哪怕定光在外面喊师兄救命，他也顶多掀开麻布一角，瞅上两眼。
吹灭屋内油灯，鱼吞舟坐上床榻，以一种较为舒适的姿势开始调息，凝神，进入了服气法的修行中。
鼻息渐渐绵长，他的心神也随之空明，却始终没能从身静迈入另一个层次。
这一次，鱼吞舟没能由静入定。
他察觉到了这一点，失望如投石入湖，荡开层层涟漪，扰乱了他的呼吸节奏。
在察觉到这一点后，他复归平静。
昨夜入定，太过突兀，他自身都不知是如何进入的这一领域，今夜不能复刻，也是情理之中，没必要执着于此。
不能入定，又不是没事做了。
鱼吞舟继续吞吐导引，搬运内气。
没有了入定的内视相助，他就像被蒙住了眼睛，呼吸法的修行，难免磕磕碰碰。
他并未因此而焦急，越是出乱，他反而走的越慢，就像一场无形的角力，他选择稳中求胜。
片刻后。
丹田内那缕原本滞涩的内气，重现步入了正轨，吸气时引天地清气入体，呼气时涤荡体内浊气。
一切都基本恢复成昨夜的情况。
伴随呼吸法的运行，内气运转不休，自然壮大，其进步速度明显还超过了昨日。
有一股温和的力量正在“火上浇油”
这是龙鱼的功效。

一切都在变得有条不紊，慢慢向上，一步一个脚印，就像鱼吞舟渴求的人生那样。
他的心神愈发沉静安宁，在这种状态下，他竟慢慢跨过一条无形的界限。
由静入定。
没有刻意地追寻，就只是……
水到渠成？
果然是水到渠成。
他的心中生出淡淡的喜悦，却不影响当下的心境，就如站在高处，低头俯瞰着自身。
这份入定，就像是一种呼吸。
正如人不需要知道如何呼吸也能呼吸。
他也在不自知的情况下，掌握了入定。
此刻。
他就像在询问自己，你方才做了什么？
答案是什么也没做，他就只是一如既往地，做着自己当下能做到的事，就像练拳，就像照看菜园，并为之做得更好，最终从这些事中获得了圆满具足，从而由静入定。
content_en:
;;
Yu Tunzhou hurried back into the house, not only closed the door, but also found linen cloth and covered the window.
Listen to others and eat enough.
In the nights that followed, even if Dingguang was outside calling his senior brother for help, he would at most lift a corner of the linen cloth and take a quick look.
After blowing out the oil lamp in the house, Yu Tunzhou sat on the bed, started to adjust his breath in a more comfortable posture, concentrated his mind, and entered into the practice of the Qi Subduing Method.
His breathing gradually became longer, and his mind became clearer, but he was still unable to move from body stillness to another level.
This time, Yutunzhou failed to calm down.
He noticed this, and his disappointment was like throwing a stone into a lake, causing ripples and disrupting his breathing rhythm.
After realizing this, he regained his composure.
Entering trance last night was so sudden that he didn't even know how he entered this realm. It was reasonable that he couldn't repeat it tonight, and there was no need to be obsessed with it.
If you can't enter samadhi, it's not like you have nothing to do.
The fish swallowing boat continues to swallow and guide, transporting the inner energy.
Without the help of inner vision, he was like being blindfolded, and his practice of breathing methods would inevitably be bumpy.
He was not anxious because of this. The more chaos happened, the slower he walked. It was like an invisible wrestling. He chose to win steadily.
After a while.
The originally stagnant inner Qi in the Dantian is back on track. When inhaling, the pure Qi from heaven and earth is introduced into the body, and when exhaling, the turbid Qi in the body is washed away.
Everything is basically back to how it was last night.
With the operation of the breathing method, the inner Qi circulates continuously and naturally grows stronger, and its progress speed is obviously faster than yesterday.
There is a moderate force that is "adding fuel to the fire"
This is the effect of arowana.
Everything is becoming orderly, slowly moving upward, step by step, just like the life that a fish swallows and a boat longs for.
His mind became calmer and more peaceful. In this state, he slowly crossed an invisible boundary.
From stillness to concentration.
No deliberate pursuit, just...
Everything comes naturally?
Sure enough, it all fell into place.
A faint joy arose in his heart, but it did not affect his current state of mind, just like standing on a high place, looking down at himself.
This meditation is like breathing.
Just as one does not need to know how to breathe in order to breathe.
He also mastered meditation without knowing it.
now.
It was like he was asking himself, what did you just do?
The answer is that he did nothing. He just continued to do what he could do at the moment, such as practicing boxing and tending the vegetable garden, and did it better. In the end, he gained completeness and contentment from these things, and thus entered tranquility.
